name: A Useful Transition

typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source used style CBLSignature.
Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source used style CBLSignature.

recognitionRules: Keep the name and focus line compact above the letter.
Use Carlito paragraphs with a clear opening reason, evidence passage and courteous close.
Leave generous white space around the salutation and signature.
Describe one transferable practice in concrete terms rather than repeating every resume item.
Use green subject/focus labels and quieter green-gray contact information above dark reading paragraphs.

principles: Name the work and the contribution before describing personal qualities.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: I would bring a tested way of making difficult work easier to follow.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid unsupported expertise labels and turning prototypes into shipped outcomes.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: I made this part; the team decided what happened next.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use A USEFUL TRANSITION as a modest Carlito letterhead; no standalone symbol. In real correspondence the person’s name replaces the library identity.
invariants: Keep the name and focus line compact above the letter.
Use Carlito paragraphs with a clear opening reason, evidence passage and courteous close.
Leave generous white space around the salutation and signature.
adaptations: Adapt the first and final paragraphs to the recipient.
Retain the evidence paragraph’s factual limits across versions.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
